description.value: Crepe Delicious is a Canadian franchise concept founded in 2004, serving made-to-order sweet and savory crepes alongside handcrafted gelato available in over 100 flavors. The Tsawwassen location at 5000 Canoe Pass Way sits near Canoe Pass, offering cyclists a quick yet distinctive stop for fresh, customizable crepes ranging from Nutella-filled sweet options to heartier savory varieties with chicken, steak, or egg. The brand positions itself as an upscale alternative to traditional fast food, blending European crepe tradition with counter-service convenience.
